# Devs Forge

> Free browser-based developer tools at https://devs-forge.com

Devs Forge provides online utilities for JSON formatting, JWT decoding, regex testing,
Base64 conversion, UUID generation, HTML formatting, timestamp conversion, and more.
All tools run locally in the user's browser.

## Main pages

- Home: https://devs-forge.com/
- All tools: https://devs-forge.com/tools
- About: https://devs-forge.com/about
- Sitemap: https://devs-forge.com/sitemap.xml

## Tool pages

- JSON Formatter: https://devs-forge.com/tools/json-formatter
- JWT Decoder: https://devs-forge.com/tools/jwt-decoder
- Regex Tester: https://devs-forge.com/tools/regex-tester
- Base64 Encoder: https://devs-forge.com/tools/base64-encoder
- UUID Generator: https://devs-forge.com/tools/uuid-generator
- Color Palette Generator: https://devs-forge.com/tools/color-palette-generator
- Gradient Generator: https://devs-forge.com/tools/gradient-generator
- Markdown Previewer: https://devs-forge.com/tools/markdown-previewer
- URL Encoder: https://devs-forge.com/tools/url-encoder
- HTML Formatter: https://devs-forge.com/tools/html-formatter
- Timestamp Converter: https://devs-forge.com/tools/timestamp-converter
- JSON to TypeScript: https://devs-forge.com/tools/json-to-typescript
